question: What will be the closing value of Bitcoin (BTC-USD on Yahoo Finance) on September 6, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of BTC-USD on Yahoo Finance for 2026-09-06. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
research:
Bitcoin was trading around $62,800 to $63,000 on 2026-08-15/16, about three weeks before the 2026-09-06 resolution date. I could not load the Yahoo page itself, and most fetches were refused by the proxy, so several figures below come only from search summaries. I left out everything dated after 2026-08-16.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves to the 2026-09-06 daily close of BTC-USD on Yahoo Finance's history page. My fetch of it failed, so I cannot report the latest Yahoo close directly. [Yahoo BTC-USD history](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BTC-USD/history/)
- 2026-08-15: Robinhood's hourly prediction contracts (settled on the CF Benchmarks index) implied BTC around $62,600 to $63,000 during the day. [Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/us/en/prediction-markets/crypto/events/btc-price-on-aug-15-2026-at-9am-edt-aug-15-2026/)
- 2026-08-16: a low-authority daily note put BTC "steady at $63K", with support at $62.5k to $63k and resistance at $64k to $65k. [Pickaxe](https://www.pickaxe.io/resources/news/bitcoin-steady-at-63k-as-institutions-boost-exposure)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Spot is about $63k, roughly the middle of the 40k to 85k range, with about 21 days left.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-10 to 08-14: US spot Bitcoin ETFs had net outflows on four of five days. My own sum of the aggregator's daily figures is about -$390M (Aug 10 -$144.7M, Aug 11 +$4.9M, Aug 12 -$61.2M, Aug 13 -$131.1M, Aug 14 -$57.6M). It is a live table, so figures may have been revised. [TFTC](https://www.tftc.io/bitcoin-etf-flows/august-2026)
- 2026-08-14: Fortune's daily page listed BTC at about $62,829. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-14-2026/)
- About 2026-08-07: ETFs drew $853.5M over a five-day inflow streak, after the prior week's $61.5M outflow. [crypto.news](https://crypto.news/bitcoin-etfs-draw-853-5m-in-five-day-inflow-streak/)
- 2026-08-05: Fortune listed about $64,137. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-05-2026/)
- 2026-08-04: CoinDesk, citing Glassnode, called the $63k zone a key battleground, with whales and retail buying near the 200-week moving average. [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/08/04/bitcoin-s-usd63-000-zone-emerges-as-key-battleground-for-buyers-glassnode)
- 2026-08-03: Fortune listed about $62,707. CoinDesk said the selloff from $65k reflected thin volume rather than panic selling. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-03-2026/), [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/08/03/live-updates-traders-say-bitcoin-sell-off-from-usd65-000-points-to-thin-volume-not-panic-selling)
- 2026-08-02: 24/7 Wall St. put BTC near $63k. It named $60k as support (BTC closed below it in June) and gave a bear case of $55k to $58k. [24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/cryptocurrency/2026/08/02/bitcoin-price-prediction-what-price-will-btc-hit-in-august/)

## 4. Base rates and volatility
- July 2026 monthly candle: open about $58,562, high about $66,910, close about $62,814. I found only this one source for it. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/bitcoin-price-from-2020-to-now)
- 2026 lows: about $60,062 on 2026-02-06, and roughly $58k to $60k in late June or early July. Sources conflict on the exact level and date. The peak was about $126k in October 2025, so the drawdown was about 52%. [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/bitcoin-down-32-percent-year-after-record/), [Mudrex](https://mudrex.com/learn/has-bitcoin-bottomed/)
- Trend: BTC has been range-bound between about $58k and $67k since June.
- Implied volatility: Deribit's DVOL index (30-day implied volatility) closed at 46.17 on 2026-06-04, the latest value I could find. [Glassnode](https://studio.glassnode.com/charts/derivatives.DvolOhlc?a=BTC)
- My own calculation: 45 to 50% annualized volatility over 21 days gives a one-standard-deviation move of about 11 to 12%. From $63k that is roughly ±$7k (about $56k to $70k), and two standard deviations is about $49k to $78k.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket has a "What price will Bitcoin hit in August 2026?" market (launched 2026-08-01, about $28M volume) plus daily and weekly markets. The search snapshots were stale or post-cutoff, so I could not get usable odds as of 2026-08-16. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/what-price-will-bitcoin-hit-in-august-2026)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold market specifically on the 2026-09-06 price.
- A Yahoo-published roundup of AI-model forecasts said BTC needs to hold $60k to $63k and then reclaim $65k to $70k to break its downtrend. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/crypto/articles/ai-predicts-bitcoin-price-august-144218748.html)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-08-27 to 08-29: Kansas City Fed Jackson Hole symposium, with a keynote by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh (in office since 2026-05-22). The policy rate is 3.50 to 3.75%. [REX Shares](https://www.rexshares.com/jackson-hole-explained/)
- Daily ETF flows: these swung between inflows and outflows in early August.
- US data: July PCE is typically released in late August, and the August jobs report on the first Friday of September (about 2026-09-04). I did not verify either date.
- 2026-09-06 is a Sunday. Crypto trades every day, so Yahoo will post a close for that date.
